profile.web_playable: Yes — classic Flash-era web game with HTML5 ports on kids' game sites.
profile.onboarding: Drops the player straight into a small first maze, with a short text note showing the arrow-key controls.
profile.controls: Arrow keys held to move; some versions support mouse.
profile.core_loop: Find the path from start to finish before an opponent or timer runs out.
profile.goals_and_rewards: Reach the exit to unlock the next, larger maze, with a small celebration on completion.
profile.difficulty_curve: Mazes grow steadily larger across levels, with time pressure as the main added difficulty.
profile.game_feel: Simple, crisp grid-based movement with immediate directional response.
profile.art_and_audio: Bright cartoon art style with basic sound effects.
profile.session_length: About 1-3 minutes per maze, with many mazes to work through.
profile.usability: Goal is very clear throughout, conveyed via short text instructions.
profile.accessibility: Paths are colour-coded for clarity, but the game requires reading and sustained held-key input, and the timer adds pressure not suited to a 5-7 bracket.
profile.ads_and_purchases: Hosting sites typically show ads around the game; no in-game purchases known.
profile.notes: Ads and time pressure are flagged only, not recommended for adoption; the useful comparison point for mazle is purely the multi-level size ramp, which mazle currently lacks entirely.
